== Argument against deletion ==
I do not agree with the notion that this image serves no purpose. Although it seems like it is documenting something silly and mundane, it is actually a valid demonstration of how Scout bodies are [[Scout#Trivia|physically simulated]]. If in the future this image is not deemed to be a suitable overview image for the [[Scout]] page, it should be moved into the Trivia section, or a dedicated Gallery section along with <u>File:Scout physics bug.png</u>. [[User:Jack5Official|Jack5Official]] ([[User talk:Jack5Official|talk]]) 21:30, 11 September 2025 (UTC)

== No place for this image ==
Currently there is no article that this image fits in. The only article that could support it at the moment is {{peak_game}}, but it doesn't feel right to include an error message image in such a location. If a better article is created that talks specifically about the multiplayer of PEAK or its engine, then this image should be placed there. [[User:Jack5Official|Jack5Official]] ([[User talk:Jack5Official|talk]]) 11:54, 12 September 2025 (UTC)

== Emote wheel image needs updating ==
Update this image to reflect the first page of the emote wheel in the new game. Use the same dimensions and cropping as the original image. [[User:Jack5Official|Jack5Official]] ([[User talk:Jack5Official|talk]]) 11:05, 6 November 2025 (UTC)
